name: Oiran Rouge -Oiran Tsuyabeni-
original_name: オイランルージュ －花魁艶紅－
source:
After his father’s sudden death, Kamon was forced to take over the family brothel Takaseya in the red light district of Yoshiwara in Edo. However, the debt collectors soon found out that the business had been passed on to someone who was inexperienced and came to take everything away. With the intervention of the local boss, he was able to keep the building which was now low on reputation, one lone tayuu Hisasa and several lower-grade courtesans, a handful of money and a girl that his father had picked up from somewhere, Amane. He decides to work hard to become one of the top tourist destinations in town.

[Taken from Micchi's [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]blog[/url]]

A brothel management SLG.
translation:
父亲骤然去世后，嘉门不得不接手位于江户吉原花街的家族妓院“高濑屋”。
然而，收债人很快发现这门生意传给了一个毫无经验的人，便前来试图夺走一切。
在当地头目的干预下，他保住了名声已然低落的店面、唯一一名太夫氷笹和数名低等游女、少许钱财，以及父亲不知从何处带回的女孩天音。
他决心努力经营，使其成为城中首屈一指的游览去处。

[摘自Micchi的[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]博客[/url]]
